desc: time posterized — the frame refreshes in slow swept ticks

params.name: rate
params.help: how often the sweep comes round — bass shoves it forward for an early tick

params.name: shape
params.help: wipe down, wipe across, or blocks dealt in bayer order

params.name: hold
params.help: 0 lets live video ghost through everywhere; 1 freezes each cell solid until its tick

params.name: cells
params.help: how many stripes or blocks the screen is dealt into
